items.title: Show HN: Ruscal: A Turbo Pascal to Rust Transpiler
items.contentSnippet:
Ruscal is a fairly-complete and well-tested Turbo Pascal to Rust transpiler, so you can run your old Turbo Pascal programs on modern computers. It supports mixing Rust and Turbo Pascal, embedding either way. It also supports graphics, including turtle graphics. I also included tools for pretty printing Turbo Pascal and converting old binary files to JSON. Great pain was taken to ensure accuracy with the original Turbo Pascal.

items.title: Show HN: Toggles, a game based on analyzing data
items.contentSnippet:
Hey, I'm Matt. This is a free game I built in the spirit of the old internet. Just built for fun and no other reason. I built a version 2-3 years ago by hand. This time I built it assisted by Claude Code.
Every day you set a toggle. On/off, dials, etc. Every single one of them follows some piece of public data.
